test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

The committee has careful / considered the report which you sent us / and has decided to take action.

options.text: and has decided to take action.
considered the report which you sent us

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The committee has careful .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is incorrect because of the phrase **"has careful"**.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"has carefully considered"** to indicate that the committee has thoughtfully examined the report.

Correct sentence: *The committee has **carefully considered** the report which you sent us and has decided to take action*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Adverbs:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + has/have + adverb + past participle
 
• **Example:** She has thoroughly checked the documents.
 
• **Usage: **Describes how an action was performed, modifying the verb.
